openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo.description: OpenAI Whisper large v3 turbo via DeepInfra's OpenAI-compatible transcription API
openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo.pricingNotes: DeepInfra lists openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo at $0.00020/min, stored as $0.012/hr. Free credits, discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: DeepInfra publishes OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text routes and model pages for its batch ASR deployments, but current public docs do not publish fixed multipart upload or duration caps for the OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint. AutoShow therefore keeps v1 split policy metadata notes-only and relies on retry-with-split when the provider rejects an oversized payload.
